crossRefs.note: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, and Gezer with…

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Gaza
people.line: Philistine city; Samson's exploits; Philip's ministry

people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Naaran
people.line: A border town between Ephraim and Benjamin

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
translations.bsb: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
translations.kjv: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
translations.asv: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Azzah and the towns thereof;
